correctness.rationale: Polynomial long division verified that g divides x^15+1 with quotient 1+x²+x³+x⁴+x⁶. Its six shifts have distinct leading degrees and rank six. Independent hyperplane/coset enumeration generated all 2,824 message spaces and computed support from the sum of all word weights on each divided by 2^(r−1), rather than the frozen script's basis-support union. Every bin, the hierarchy (6,9,11,13,14,15) and all six minimizer counts agree. The ordinary distribution also agrees by independently comparing all 64 words to arrays a_i+b_j with a and b even, in CRT order.
residual_risks: The cited Example 2 attribution was not reverified in the inaccessible original; numerical claims are for the expressly fixed polynomial, independently of its attribution.

evidence: The check polynomial factors as (x²+x+1)(1+x+x²+x³+x⁴). The period-3 and period-5 repeats of their even codes are annihilated by the respective factors under shift. Their intersection is zero (the only common constant even repeat is zero), and the dimensions sum to six. CRT makes these words a_i+b_j on edges of K_{3,5}; the total parity of a cut is the sum of vertex label parities, and the global flip puts both separately even exactly for even cuts. Exhaustive comparison verified this alias. The frozen parameter-matching comparator has a different ordinary weight enumerator and thus cannot be equivalent if its quoted enumerator is correct.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: The even-weight cut space has dimension six, whereas the full cut space has dimension seven; a table for the latter or its ordinary cycle-space dual is not an identified table for this subcode.

value.rationale: The fixed natural cyclic code also describes even cuts of a small complete bipartite graph. Its table counts all simultaneous cut supports, including 40 extremal two-spaces and 11 two-spaces meeting every coordinate. These incidence-sensitive counts distinguish it from alternatives with the same parameters and are useful beyond confirming its already-known minimum distance.
residual_risks: Not a family-level formula, orbit classification or claim about every optimal length-15 code.
